enemies.name: Ashen Ashigaru
enemies.notes: Paper-armoured foot soldier. Once per battle it repaints itself mid-fight, restoring 1 plate, unless a [FIRE] hit lands first (the repaint effect must be cancelled for the rest of the battle once any FIRE hit has landed on it). U1: spawns only during Crimson Night; its Break leaves a lingering ink puddle mixed with an amber shard.

enemies.name: Ashen Ashigaru — Porcelain Captain
enemies.notes: Leads line formations (the ashigaru around it form a line behind it). Leaves a VHS Fog trail wherever it walks. Weeps clear oil from sorrowful blue eyes. Break: its head mask falls and shows the same galaxy interior as Crono's chest. Sprite reuses the ashigaru sheet (no captain row in the manifest).

enemies.name: Ink Calligrapher
enemies.notes: Writes kanji in the air that become hitboxes on the battle plane for 2 s (the stroke persists as a hazard after the action). Wet edges deal the ink DoT: every stroke lives 2 s then bleeds 15%; anything touching a wet edge takes the ink DoT.

enemies.name: Gourd-Bloated Heimin
enemies.notes: A townsman who drank from the same vein as Krona. Break: bursts into an Ash Field (enemies inside 0.5x movement, -1 temporary plate per 2 s; Krona feeds on it). Krona's dialogue changes if she is in the party.

enemies.name: Surrender Petition Yokai
enemies.notes: Origami folded from the Shogun's petitions. Evades every hit while unpainted (an 'unpainted' state the brain must track: all hits miss); Cobalt Wash or any [INK] hit paints it and ends the evasion for the rest of the battle.

enemies.name: Crimson Banner Samurai
enemies.notes: Holds a 2 s ink pose before each slash (the wind-up is the parry window): the Ens Parry teacher. The four Iron Bridge shrines are built around these ash-ronin forcing a held parry.

enemies.name: Omen Crow (VHS)
enemies.notes: Circles high over the plane (out of melee reach while circling) and dives, applying BLIND (VHS Fog) and Grief. Porcelain feather tips. Break: frozen mid-dive with wings spread; the wings are a bridge (Break cover usable as traversal).

enemies.name: Imp-Crackle Sumi
enemies.notes: Swarm. On death it paints the terrain sumi for 10 s; enemies crossing the paint move at half speed (allies are unaffected).
